picks.thesis: Bear call spread on QQQ with a short call delta of 0.3063 sits near the middle of the 0.25‑0.35 band, offering a high credit‑to‑width of 0.31 (0.31 credit for a 1‑point width) and a ~70% chance of profit with only 1 day to expiration.

Bull put spread on QQQ with a short put delta of -0.3449 is also near the ideal -0.25 to -0.35 range, delivering a solid credit‑to‑width of 0.25 (0.25 credit for a 1‑point width) and roughly a 65% probability of expiring OTM, all with 1 day left.
